implementation_summary: Extended tools/repository_context.py with RCAB-MAP-V1 registry parsing from docs/CONTEXT-MAP.md between BEGIN/END markers, deterministic manifest generation at baselines/repository-context-manifest-v1.json, blocking integrity checks (malformed/duplicate/missing/untracked/stale/tampered), and the D047 non-blocking bootstrap/router warning ratchet. The manifest projects registered entries with path, class, routes, byte_size, line_count, sha256; derives registered_content_digest from ordered path+content identities; computes bootstrap/router current totals against the accepted T030-R2 reference (2 files, 21471 bytes, 298 lines, 5% warning threshold); and surfaces warning only when cohort exceeds 2 files or aggregate UTF-8 bytes exceed 105% of reference. Warning-only run exits success unless an integrity failure is present. The manifest avoids self-reference (its own path excluded from content identity) and does not embed any Git commit SHA. T030 behavior fully preserved (all existing functions, signatures, and tests unchanged). T020 artifact isolation preserved (no schemas/ governance-core/ governance-skill/ src/agent_governance/ changes). No new dependencies, no network access, no Markdown edits. 19 focused deterministic tests added covering AC-RCAB-1..6. Full suite: 289 passed (up from 270).

architecture.source_boundary: tools/repository_context.py remains source-only under tools/, outside src/agent_governance, governance-core, governance-skill, and the T020 Consumer artifact boundary.
architecture.registry_parsing: parse_registry() extractts exactly one RCAB-MAP-V1:BEGIN/END marker pair from docs/CONTEXT-MAP.md, parses the JSON code fence between them, and raises MeasurementError on malformed JSON, missing/duplicate markers, or missing END before BEGIN.
architecture.integrity_checks: validate_registry() checks schema version, entry structure, unique paths, valid classes (bootstrap/router/focused/task/evidence/generated-index/generated-data/exempt-on-demand), valid routes, bootstrap_ratchet fields, and that every registered path exists as a tracked Git path. No semantic inference from Markdown prose, reference counts, filenames, or heuristics.
architecture.manifest_generation: build_manifest() produces a canonical JSON projection sorted by path with: projection_schema_version, registry_digest (SHA-256 of canonical registry JSON), registered_paths (path/class/routes/byte_size/line_count/sha256), registered_content_digest (SHA-256 of ordered path+sha256 identity), and bootstrap_router (current/accepted_reference/delta/warning/ratchet_candidate). written via write_manifest() using atomic tempfile replacement and canonical_json() for byte determinism.
architecture.self_reference_avoidance: The manifest path is excluded from its own registered_content_digest via write_manifest() excluded_paths. The manifest does not embed any Git commit SHA, volatile_execution_metadata, or timestamp. Freshness is determined by registered_content_digest, not by commit SHA.
architecture.ratchet_semantics: _compute_ratchet() computes bootstrap+router file_count/byte_size/line_count from registered entries with class in {bootstrap, router}. Warning activates when file_count > reference.file_count or byte_size > reference.byte_size * (1 + warning_relative_growth). Warning is non-blocking. Ratchet_candidate reported (but not applied) when current footprint is below accepted reference. Delta ratios computed deterministically.
architecture.check_mode: check_manifest() regenerates the manifest from current registry+content and compares byte-for-byte against the committed manifest. Returns (0, 'manifest OK') on match, (0, 'manifest OK (warning: ...)') on match with active warning, or (1, 'manifest is stale or tampered ...') on mismatch. Integrity failures (raised MeasurementError) cause exit 1 via CLI error handler.
architecture.cli_extension: main() extended with --manifest (generate projection), --check-manifest PATH (check committed manifest), and --map PATH (override context map location). Default behavior (no new flags) is unchanged T030 report generation.
architecture.no_enforcement: Generation and check do not rewrite Markdown, split files, change policy, introduce dependencies, access network, or fail solely because a focused/evidence file is physically large.
